name: What role does finish carpentry and molding play in an interior remodel?

mainEntity.name: What role does finish carpentry and molding play in an interior remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interior finish carpentry includes installing baseboards, crown molding, door casings, custom mantels, and decorative trim that give rooms an architectural identity. It bridges the gaps where drywall meets flooring, doors, and ceilings, creating clean, polished transitions. Quality finish carpentry requires precise miters, secure fastening into studs, and smooth caulking before painting. Selecting the right profiles and trim heights depends on your ceiling height, room proportions, and whether you prefer modern square-edge trim or traditional multi-piece molding.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finish carpentry adds architectural detail and clean transitions between surfaces using baseboards, crown molding, door casings, and custom trim.
